intro: Aelthalyste is a banshee priest trainer and prominent figure within the Cult of Forgotten Shadows, stationed in the War Quarter of the Undercity. She oversees the spiritual discipline of Forsaken acolytes, teaching them to wield the dark energies of Shadow. She also coordinates with other Horde faith leaders, directing troll acolytes to their own elders in Orgrimmar.

p: Unlike many priests across Azeroth who revere the Holy Light, Aelthalyste guides the Forsaken through the tenets of the Cult of Forgotten Shadows. Rising as an incorporeal banshee, she embodies the spectral agony and relentless resolve of Sylvanas Windrunner's followers. From her chamber in the Undercity's War Quarter, she calls aspiring priests back from distant outposts to master the darker arts of their discipline, teaching them to harness suffering as a lethal weapon.

While her focus remains firmly on her Forsaken flock, Aelthalyste maintains mutual respect with other Horde spiritual practitioners. Recognizing the distinct nature of Darkspear spiritualism, she directs troll initiates away from her own shadow doctrines and sends them across the sea to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar. This gesture of deference ensures that Horde spellcasters develop within their cultural traditions while cementing alliances between Kalimdor and Lordaeron.
